items.headline: Hydrologic Outlook issued September 14 at 3:13PM AKDT by NWS Anchorage AK
items.description:
ESFAFC

Locations:

* Willow and Talkeetna
* Rivers, creeks, and streams with headwaters along the western
Talkeetna Mountains

Timing:

* This (Monday) evening through Wednesday afternoon. Heaviest
rainfall expected late Tuesday morning through Tuesday night.

Rainfall:

* Rainfall totals of 1 to 3 inches Monday through Wednesday likely
won't be high enough for widespread flooding, but smaller
tributaries draining the Talkeetnas including Willow Creek and the
Little Susitna may reach bankfull.

items.headline: High Surf Advisory issued September 14 at 1:30PM AKDT until September 16 at 1:00AM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Water levels of 2 to 4 feet above the mean high tide
line.

* WHERE...Yukon Delta Coast.

* WHEN...From 4 AM Tuesday to 1 AM AKDT Wednesday.

* IMPACTS...Localized beach erosion may occur. In Scammon Bay,
water may reach up to the boat launch.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Water may rise along the Kun River and
typical low lying areas may see minor inundation. The highest
waters are expected in Scammon Bay and Hooper Bay.
items.instruction: Precautions should be taken to protect property.
